critical_code_review_comments: be_extras.check_funnel_alerts: When previous 7d has no baseline (base=None), only triggers on drop>=60 (hardcoded). Configurable would be better. Currently guarded by min_sessions=20 anyway.
be_payments.create_intent installments branch: is_deposit set True when amount_mode=='installments' so Customer + setup_future_usage is attached — required for off_session charge. Correct.

be_payment_plans.schedule_installments: last-installment `amount = round(total - paid - per*(remaining-1), 2)` correctly balances rounding drift. Due date uses min(check_in-charge_days, today+30*i) so last installment respects the check_in-7d cutoff. Good.

be_payment_plans.run_payment_schedules installments branch has `break` after first scheduled entry - only one installment charged per run. This is safe (idempotent per cron tick every 6h) but if multiple installments are overdue they'll only be caught one-per-run. Consider removing break or run more frequently near due dates.
be_gaps DEFAULTS: installments_enabled defaults True globally — properties without explicit opt-in will show the installments option. May be intentional but consider default False if pilot rollout.
